title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Spicy, saucy ground chicken spooned into crisp butter lettuce cups with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lime. Faster than delivery and twice as satisfying.

steps.text: Whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce, and sambal oelek in a small bowl. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the scallions and garlic and cook, stirring, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the ground chicken, season lightly with salt, and cook, breaking it into small pieces with a wooden spoon, until cooked through with some browned bits, 5 to 7 minutes.
steps.tip: Let the chicken sit undisturbed for a minute here and there — that's how you get those crispy, caramelized bits that make this worth eating.

steps.text: Pour in the sauce and cook, tossing occasionally, until the liquid reduces to a sticky glaze, about 2 minutes.
Spoon the chicken into lettuce cups and top with fresh herbs, extra sambal, and a squeeze of lime.
